messages:
maria: Quick heads-up /generate-route p95 jumped ~110ms after the priority-aging deploy at ~18:12 UTC. p50 unchanged. Seeing it in canary gating.

alex: I see it too. Live traces show low-priority requests have higher queue_wait. Could be preemption causing smaller batches.

jin: Quick rollup probe:
```
SELECT priority, phase, percentile(latency_ms,95) p95, count(*) samples
FROM traces
WHERE endpoint='/generate-route' AND ts > now() - interval '6 hours'
GROUP BY priority, phase
```
high-pri p95 ~80ms (120k), low-pri p95 ~380ms (4k); queue phase dominates low-pri p95.

sam: p99 barely moved, so looks like mid-tail cohort shift. Also check sampler bias for canaries.

lia: Note: we route to variant-b when queue_depth>1100; variant-b adds ~90ms for some payloads and audit logs show switches during the window.

telemetry-bot: telemetry-bot: snapshot https://redwood.internal/telemetry/snapshots/7161616900

maria: Action items: (1) surface phase-split (queue_wait vs service_time) p50/p95/p99 on the route page; (2) show sample_count next to percentiles with low-sample badge; (3) auto-annotate deploys/config changes on dashboards (PR link).

alex: I'll own the dashboard wiring and add the deploy annotation.

jin: I'll add `priority` and `phase` to rollups and include a sampling-sanity alert (flag if samples<500).

sam: UX suggestion: endpoint hover tooltip show p50/p95/p99 micro-bars split by phase. Quick triage.

maria: Nice. After PRs merge we'll re-run canary gating and decide whether to tweak aging/fallback. Thanks all.
